title: alchemilla pratensis var. heteropoda
intro: Alchemilla pratensis var. heteropoda, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herb native to Europe, known for its distinctive rosettes of leaves and clusters of small white flowers. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating menstrual irregularities, soothing digestive issues, and supporting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and astringent properties, which contribute to its ability to calm irritated tissues and reduce bleeding. The bioactive constituents present in Lady's Mantle include flavonoids, tannins, and glycosides, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
